name: app-chrome
description: Two guides and two tickets, in one Atlassian tenant, with page content read. Every Confluence page repeats the app's navigation and sidebar, so reading the page body makes two unrelated pages look identical: they scored 5.53 on 'attachments', 'templates', 'restrictions' and 'calendars' and all four tabs collapsed into one group. Reported from real use as 'same domains are categorized together without pulling context'.
